culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: At Soma Nomaoi the organisers ask viewers not to cross in front of horses or the procession, not to look down on the procession from high places, not to stand behind horses, not to use flash on horses, and not to reach out suddenly or shout at them. In rain, wear a raincoat rather than holding an umbrella, which blocks people behind.
culture-and-protocol.photography_and_story_permissions: Photographs are free outside closed areas, and your own photos may be used freely. Drones and selfie sticks are banned for safety.
culture-and-protocol.note: Soma Nomaoi only, from the organisers' FAQ.

festivals.what: Soma Nomaoi (Soma, Minamisoma and Namie): held every year over the last Saturday, Sunday and Monday of May. Day 1 departures and evening races; day 2 the armoured procession, armour horse racing and the sacred-flag contest at Hibarigahara (Minamisoma); day 3 Nomakake at Odaka Shrine. It goes ahead in rain but can be called off under weather or disaster warnings; roads around venues close.

laws.rule: Fukushima Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (福島県青少年健全育成条例), art. 25. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 10 pm to 5 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
laws.heading: 福島県青少年健全育成条例 (Fukushima), curfew for young people

laws.rule: Fukushima's 福島県迷惑行為等防止条例 (Fukushima Nuisance Acts Prevention Ordinance), art. 6, bans touching a person's body, peeping at or photographing underwear or the body under clothing, and other lewd words or acts that cause shame or alarm in public places. Breaches of arts. 6 or 7 carry up to 6 months in prison or a fine of up to JPY 500,000 (about A$4,512); habitual offending, up to 1 year or JPY 1,000,000 (about A$9,024). Yen at A$1 = JPY 110.82 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).
laws.heading: 福島県迷惑行為等防止条例 art. 6 (lewd acts and covert photography)
laws.penalty_signal: up to 6 months prison or JPY 500,000

laws.rule: Art. 5 of the same Fukushima ordinance bans unfair touting (不当な客引行為) in public places. The penalty clause for it was not extracted here. Yen at A$1 = JPY 110.82 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).
